summary.text: Michele Lundgren is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 4 Republican primary.
She describes herself as a resident of Detroit and the 9th District.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Lundgren said she wants to clean up trash, abandoned cars and vacant lots in the district and to make phone numbers, addresses and names of local resources easy for constituents to find.

On education, she said trade schools are less expensive than college and can lead to well-paying careers, and she noted that Detroit residents over 60 can attend Wayne County Community College District at reduced cost.
